storyTitle: Defend the Streak and Climb the Ranks
oneSentenceStory: Marcus checks his mobile rewards dashboard to maintain his 34-day streak and secure his top-3 leaderboard rank.
customerSituation: Active daily user with a 34-day streak and rank #3 on the community leaderboard.
storyTension: Maintaining daily streak continuity and defending leaderboard position against active peers.
customerResolution: Engaging with quick daily challenges to protect the streak and earn milestone badges.
primaryOutcome: Maintain engagement and satisfaction through recognized progress, active streaks, and community standing.
